description: Native Rust multi-agent swarm workspace with ACP, Git worktree isolation, and an automatic merge gate.
pre_install: try { & cargo install --locked --path (Join-Path $dir 'crates\hadron-chamber') --root $dir --force; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "cargo install failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" } } finally { if ($null -eq $oldTarget) { Remove-Item Env:\CARGO_TARGET_DIR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $env:CARGO_TARGET_DIR = $oldTarget } }
notes: Hadron currently publishes source-only GitHub releases. This Scoop package builds the official tagged source with the local Rust toolchain during install/update.
